'''4th Squadron''' was a formation of [[S-1 FireHawke Heavy Repulsortank]]s assigned to the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit's]] [[Armor Troop Zerek]]. It participated in the [[Battle of Turak IV]] where tank [[Hammer 4:3]] was disabled during the initial charge.
